title: Conclave Elects Leo XIV, the First American Pope
dek: White smoke over the Sistine Chapel. The cardinals elected Robert Francis Prevost.
body: 8 May 2025, the fourth ballot. The first pope from the United States.

panels.label: Schneck Said
panels.text: Stephen Schneck said the balcony address shows Leo will be a continuation of Francis, in the tradition of Francis, with the emphasis on solidarity and the marginalized.

panels.label: Pattenden Said
panels.text: Miles Pattenden said the red stole Francis had set aside signals some degree of conservatism, and that the cardinals wanted a pope who could restore order to the operations Francis left behind.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Schneck speaks of continuity with Francis and Pattenden of order restored. At stake is the next center of gravity: a missionary formed in Peru, or a curia returned to order, and the national churches under it.
